title: Apply additive content insets
description: Apply a uniform or independent top, right, bottom, and left content inset as a second inward reduction after requested tolerance, keeping it distinct from sheet margins and tolerance.
acceptanceCriteria: Content inset supports one uniform value or explicit top/right/bottom/left finite non-negative millimetre values
Content region is derived from the TASK-52 safe area, so inset adds clearance after requested tolerance
Sheet-layout margins, requested tolerance, and content inset remain separately named and persisted
Extreme or contradictory inset values return side-specific diagnostics and no invalid content region
Normalization produces equivalent sides for equivalent uniform and four-side input

steps.details: Add discriminated uniform and per-side inset input, normalize to four named millimetre sides, and reject negative or non-finite values.
Inset the TASK-52 safe region a second time while preserving separate requested-tolerance and content-inset fields in SafeRegionResult.
Detect collapsed width/height or incompatible rounded geometry and return side- and constraint-specific diagnostics rather than clamping silently.
Cover uniform, asymmetric, zero, extreme, negative, and non-finite insets and assert content clearance equals requested tolerance plus the applicable inset.

technicalNotes: Timebox to normalization and one second-offset operation with focused geometry tests.
Additional inset is a user choice and does not transform requested tolerance into a physically established safe margin.
